# has descendant

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasDescendant`](gmeow-hasDescendant.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasDescendant>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/genealogy`](../../slices/genealogy.md)

Relates a person to a descendant — a child, a child's child, and so on; the transitive inverse of [`gmeow:hasAncestor`](gmeow-hasAncestor.md). Derived by the reasoner ([`gmeow:hasChild`](gmeow-hasChild.md) is a sub-property), never asserted directly.
